message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard.
• If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color and the next player draws four cards. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you’re penalized.) | | **Uno Call** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards remaining in the other players’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. First to reach the agreed‑upon point total (e.g., 500) wins the game. | **Optional Variations** - **Stacking**: Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing. - **No “Wild Draw Four” rule**: Some groups forbid playing Wild Draw Four unless you have no other playable card. - **Custom Decks**: Use themed decks or add extra cards for house rules. That’s the core of Uno—simple, fast, and a lot of fun!
